QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_16

question.text: Typical annual Trusteeship Fees for an AIF are in the range of:

answer.text: INR 1 lakh to INR 5 lakh per year depending on fund size
INR 50 lakh to INR 1 crore per year

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.1: Trusteeship Fees are typically FIXED at INR 1 lakh to INR 5 lakh per year depending on fund size (as agreed in the offer letter with the Trustee). The Trap: Option B is unrealistic. Options C and D confuse Trusteeship with Management Fee. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A covers this number; XIX-C expects a manager to negotiate it down for multi-scheme trusts. Manager's Pro-Tip: If your Sponsor runs multiple AIFs under one Trustee, negotiate a 'group trusteeship fee' across schemes — saves meaningful cost. SEBI Trustee approval must be on file before First Close; renegotiating mid-cycle is disruptive.
